description: This file defines an immutable implementation of the JsonKey interface, providing methods to create and manipulate JSON key objects with immutability guarantees.

classes.name: ImmutableJsonKey
classes.description: A final, immutable class implementing JsonKey, representing a JSON key with a final String value and providing factory methods for creation.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static factory method to create a JsonKey instance from a CharSequence, returning an existing JsonKey if applicable, otherwise creating a new ImmutableJsonKey.

methods.name: asPointer
methods.description: Returns a JsonPointer representation of this key using JsonFactory.

methods.name: length
methods.description: Returns the length of the key string.

methods.name: charAt
methods.description: Returns the character at the specified index in the key string.

methods.name: subSequence
methods.description: Returns a subsequence of the key string from start to end.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks if this ImmutableJsonKey is equal to another object based on the key value.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Returns a hash code based on the key value.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the key value.
